display_information.name: Lucy Pitch Auditor
display_information.description: Send me a recording of your pitch. I send back who said what.
display_information.long_description: DM Lucy Pitch Auditor a recording of a door pitch (a Voice Memo or a Slack audio clip). A minute or two later she replies with the whole conversation, every line marked Rep or Customer, plus how much each side talked. A copy goes to your coach so they can give you feedback.
